payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics comparing the SubGram model to the Skip-gram model, indicating the gains achieved by the SubGram model.

claims.text: The SubGram model outperforms the Skip-gram model on the same training set, achieving 22.4% compared to Skip-gram's 9.7%.
The Skip-gram model trained on a larger dataset achieves a performance of 43.5%, which is higher than both SubGram and the original Skip-gram model.
The SubGram model shows improvement over the Skip-gram model, which had a zero score on average for semantic relations.
